item.title: US Army member arrested in UK over allegations of spying for Russia
item.description: The unnamed soldier was arrested by British counterterrorism police “working closely” with U.S. authorities, including the FBI and the military, the Metropolitan Police said in a statement.

item.title: Microsoft’s Patch Tuesday surpasses 1,000 bugs for second month in a row
item.description: An exploited Outlook vulnerability drew most of the attention in Microsoft's latest Patch Tuesday, which listed 1,093 bugs total.

item.title: AI company Fireworks says hackers stole data, billing info during October breaches
item.description: Fireworks said the incident affected a “limited number of customer accounts” — all of whom were notified of the attack.
